# A handover note for a real absence

I will be away for two weeks. Wrote who can remove an extract, reset the printer and approve a label correction. Three people now own these choices. [[Exhibition plan]] becomes useful again as a pattern for transferring responsibility, without reopening the harbour archive. Ask the recipients which parts remain unclear before I leave.
